  - `.bst` parsing + compilation: `output/src/bst.rs`
  - `.bst` VM + built-ins + JSON log struct: `output/src/vm.rs`
  - Cite/aux parsing + CLI args: `output/src/cli.rs`
  - 79-column output wrapping: `output/src/wrap.rs`
  - Name parsing/formatting helpers: `output/src/names.rs`
  - Structured JSON writer (no deps): `output/src/json.rs`

Build/run:
- `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --bib <path> --style <path> --cites <path>|--aux <path> --output <path> [--log <path>]`
